theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (W : Set (Euclid P)) (v : Euclid P → ℝ) (β θ : ℝ), MeasurableSet W → volume W ≠ ∞ → IntegrableOn v W → 0 < θ → θ * (volume W).toReal ≤ (volume (W ∩ {y | β ≤ v y})).toReal → θ * (volume W).toReal ≤ (volume (W ∩ {y | v y ≤ β})).toReal → ∫ y in W, |v y - β| ≤ (1 + θ⁻¹) * ((volume W).toReal)⁻¹ * ∫ x in W, ∫ y in W, |v x - v y|
